coder_notes: Platform sub-study with two molecularly defined biomarker cohorts (BRAF hyperactivating mutation/fusion; NF1 loss) defined in the detailed description; registered arms are labelled by phase only, so biomarker arms are given as both 'Phase 1b' and 'Phase 2'. The biomarker cohorts are coded as enrichment (required per cohort); since all patients must belong to one, an adjudicator could treat them as eligibility. Both are MAPK-pathway markers matched to avutometinib (RAF/MEK inhibitor); defactinib (FAK) is the combination partner. MGMT unmethylated status is mentioned only in an outcome for the front-line MRD cohort; assigned to 'Phase 2' because the description places front-line MRD testing in Phase 2, though the outcome text lists it under Phase 1b. Eligibility also includes IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma and H3 G34-mutant glioma (mixed glioma). Temozolomide only in Phase 2 arm as standard-of-care maintenance (soc_backbone); regimen combination. Ages include 16+ (CHILD in stdAges).
